short_description: Standalone evolutionary ecosystem research: grow ecology from landscape/history without player or biome species tables, then later transfer and continue the same ecology inside the world simulator.
purpose: Build a reusable autonomous evolutionary ecology mini-project that evolves plant and later multi-trophic ecosystems from causal environment/resource/competition/history rules, exports portable spatial ecology state, and eventually feeds World Generation/local/background simulation without duplicate ecology truth.
progress_note: CAL1-F is accepted on exact Windows Godot 4.7.1 double with aggregate f531fe844ceaa77094f6d259601f0df2f4b8b421328a221a1bab14196ccad1ed and classification ROBUST_UNITY_CALIBRATION. Five deterministic phenotype seeds produced five signatures with 100% multi-member Pareto retention; density and disturbance sweeps had zero monotonicity violations; +/-15% mechanism perturbations preserved Pareto membership with min/mean Jaccard 1.0; five pool compositions remained valid; pairwise/full-pool resource contradictions were zero. EVO0/CAL1 is complete. EVO1/P2.1 is now the only executable research step and begins autonomous spatial plant-state evolution.
next_stage: Implement P2.1 deterministic seed dispersal as a spatial transport kernel over portable seed/cohort truth. It must conserve emitted seed mass/count, preserve lineage identity, respond to inherited dispersal distance and release-height lifecycle output, support deterministic anisotropic environmental transport without biome/species placement tables, and remain independent of establishment/recruitment which belongs to P2.2.
